Docstring wrongly types r as 'float: distance' and never states displacement direction; h5 test-2 target is a positive multiple of r (attraction toward j), so r must be i->j — Allen-Tildesley r_i-r_j reading is the exact negative.

Printed p_tail lacks 1/V^2 (dimensionally an energy); h5 target -2.23402e-4 = printed/L^6 x10 (zJ/nm^3->bar), matching the reviewer's arithmetic exactly.

h5 test-3 virial = -8.8505 bar while pair 0-3 sits at r=0.712 < 2^(1/6) (repulsive => physical virial positive); the background's i->j/force-on-i pairing indeed flips the standard virial sign.
